exclusion_reason: The reference/replay artifact is implemented as a generic recorder that reduces each checkpoint to a state hash (no raw asset byte, no personal data), a byte-stable artifact hash, and a checkpoint-by-checkpoint comparator that flags the first divergence. The benchmark stays red because the real checkpoints come from a live runtime session (BPTK-010) that does not exist, so no real run can be recorded.
promotion_trigger: Promote when two replay hash-match at every declared checkpoint and the artifact privacy proof holds.
active_gate_evidence: The replay suite covers the identical-hash match across two replays of one run, the first-divergence detection at its checkpoint index, the hash-only artifact that embeds no raw state, and the refusal of an artifact that embeds personal data or a raw state blob.
procedure: Record the fixture run and produce the reference artifact.
Replay twice and compare checkpoint hash.
Audit the artifact for embedded asset and personal data.
pass_criterion: The artifact is free of asset and personal data.
